question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**react**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage refers to the life cycle of Banana.
 
• **Blank 2 **in the sentence refers to how the Bananas produce and combine with the airborne hormone named "ethylene."
 
• Thus, among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is** "react."** 
 
 
• **"React" **means to respond or behave in a particular way in response to something.
 
• It is used about a chemical substance to change after coming into contact with another substance. (किसी रासायनिक तत्‍व में) दूसरे तत्‍व के संपर्क से परिवर्तन आ जाना)
 
 
• **Example**: *Someone allergic to milk is likely to **react**__ to cheese. *
 
 
 
 
 
• The other options do not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.
 
• Correct passage:

The life __cycle__ of a banana is a colourful one; it starts with a deep green, changes to a delicious yellow and ends at an unappetizing brown. Bananas, like most fruits, produce and __**react**__ with an airborne hormone called ethylene. This hormone helps to signal the ripening process. An unripe fruit is hard and acidic. It is likely to possess a greenish ______ (3) ______ due to the presence of chlorophyll. When a fruit comes into contact ______ (4) ______ ethylene, the acids in the fruit start to break down, it becomes softer and the green chlorophyll is ______ (5) ______ and replaced, in the case of bananas, with a yellow hue. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The verb **"correspond"** means to match or agree with something, usually in terms of communication.(अनुरूप)
 
• **"Differ" **means to be unlike or distinct from something else.(अलग होना)
 
• **"Tamper"** means to interfere with or alter something in a harmful or unauthorized way. (छेड़छाड़)

41:Tf15,

The correct answer is "**hue**".
